offering_description.value: Stagwell is a network of marketing, advertising, public relations and consulting agencies. It sells integrated brand, digital, media, data and performance marketing services to large corporate and institutional clients, and also offers proprietary marketing technology and research tools.

primary_products.value: marketing analytics software; audience and market research platforms; AI-enabled marketing technology tools

primary_services.value: digital transformation consulting; performance marketing and media buying; creative advertising; public relations and communications; market research and data analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: large corporations and brands across industries buying marketing and consulting; B2G: government and public sector agencies buying communications and research

end_markets.value: consumer goods; technology; healthcare; financial services; retail; public sector

revenue_model.value: service fees: retainer and fee-based agency work, consulting, PR and creative services; commissions or management fees: media buying and performance marketing fees and commissions; project or contract: campaigns, research studies and digital transformation projects; subscription: software and data platform subscriptions
revenue_model.category: service fees; commissions or management fees; project or contract; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: agencies taking in talent, media and data, selling marketing and consulting services to brands; software / platform: proprietary marketing technology and analytics tools sold to marketers

specialization.value: related lines: advertising, media and performance marketing, PR, research and data, digital consulting, marketing technology
